title: Location page content (canonical v2)
description: Contract for wordpress/themes/<theme>/content/locations/<slug>.json. Consumed by inc/content-loader.php, inc/seo.php, inc/cli.php, and template-parts/written-page.php. Canonical per ADR-0003; the superseded v1 shape stored prose in sections[].body and is rejected.

slug.description: Must match the filename and a service_areas item slug in business-config.php.

seo_title.description: Read directly by lvjcb_compute_seo(). SEO_STANDARDS.md §3 caps this at 60 characters after {business} resolves.

seo_description.description: Read directly by lvjcb_compute_seo(), then truncated at 155 characters by lvjcb_truncate_for_seo().

sections.description: At least one section is required. template-location.php falls back to the generic templated layout when this is empty, which is a silent failure rather than a visible one.
